description: Source code for the AudioDecoder class implementation in the starboard shared win32 platform, handling audio decoding, callback scheduling, and stream management.

classes.name: AudioDecoder::CallbackScheduler
classes.description: Manages scheduling of callback functions for audio decoding events.

methods.name: AudioDecoder::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the audio decoder with output and error callbacks.

methods.name: AudioDecoder::Decode
methods.description: Feeds input buffers into the decoder and manages callback scheduling.

methods.name: AudioDecoder::WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals the end of the audio stream.

methods.name: AudioDecoder::Read
methods.description: Retrieves decoded audio data and samples per second.

methods.name: AudioDecoder::Reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder state and clears buffers.

methods.name: AudioDecoder::OnAudioDecoded
methods.description: Handles decoded audio data and triggers output callbacks.
